Project Description

DOCK PERMITTING SURVEY

You will receive everything you need for your dock permit meeting the requirements for Canandaigua UDML. Following existing regulations of the governing bodies, we will determine the Critical Line, existing docks or structures, and edges of creeks, preparing material for a dock permit.

Since starting our company in 1985, Venezia & Associates has had ample experience working within UDML regulations and meeting the requirements for dock permits. We work closely with environmentalists and other necessary contacts to complete the dock permit process. Whether residential or commercial, we have experience completing projects of varying scale and requirements. You want a dock to enjoy the waterway by your house or for your company. We will determine the best solution for your dock that meets every requirement and makes as little impact on the landscape as possible.

We are members of this community. We care about what happens here, just like you. That’s why we take great care to help preserve the natural environment while moving forward with innovation and construction. You want positive development for Canandaigua Lakes. You want the best for the families who live here and for the future of our community. We do too. That’s why when you choose Venezia for your surveying needs, you’re making the best choice for the future of our city.

Our founder, Rocco A. Venezia has over 40 years of surveying experience, a passion he has passed to his son Anthony who has over 20 years of experience and leads the Venezia team. Combined, our company has over 60 years of surveying experience. We bring this knowledge, skill, and passion to every project. You will receive not only the collective experience of our team, but also the quality service that we are known for. Using state-of-the-art tools, we can complete surveys with greater accuracy in less time than our competitors, saving you time and money.
